evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: Attention/processing relation (A) is not present, so no C+A binding.

COD.rationale: C, O and D are present in the text, but their best-supported scopes differ (content and organization framed as display/sensor properties while status/origin uses model_access), so a single consistent COD binding is ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the reported content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly identifies content (colour-labeled coordinate sets) and attributes (red/blue) for current and conditional candidate entries.

D.rationale: The text assigns distinct origin/status metadata (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) to identified contents, distinguishing content identity from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states how content is presented/organized (coordinate orientation and sets of coordinates for attributes).
